schedule: 10s each: stop,forward,left,stop,right,forward; continuous fixed decoder state

gates.finite_complete: All10 complete60s with finite physical observations
gates.forward: At least8/10 seeds: more than10mm travel and net displacement in each forward phase
gates.turn: At least8/10 seeds: left heading change>0.5rad and right heading change<-0.5rad
gates.stopping: At least8/10 seeds: mean xy speed during38-40s below0.1mm/s
gates.no_flips: At least9/10 seeds have no flipped samples
gates.continuation: Separate fresh-process interruption reproduces all recorded rows,poses and saved physical states exactly

secondary: Contact-point tangential speeds under measured solver loads
Active stalls in1s blocks: motor RMS>0.1 and xy travel<0.1mm
scope: Artificial neuron-rate readouts through fixed decoder into supplied gait; no brain simulated, no navigation or learning claim. Engineering quality thresholds, not biological norms.
